market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from $100+ oil, Fed hike on Sept 16, and trade war expansion. Expect volatility in equities, continued Treasury weakness, and defensive rotation. Apple iPhone event may provide brief tech catalyst. Dow futures already dipping. 1-3 month outlook: choppy, risk-off bias with energy outperforming.
market_outlook.long_term: If US-Iran conflict resolves within 6 months, oil normalizes and growth reaccelerates. AI capex cycle (Google, OpenAI) supports tech leadership. Housing remains structurally challenged. Trade wars may persist 12+ months. Defense and space sectors in multi-year upcycle. Consumer recovery delayed by insurance/rate cost shocks.
